goal: Build a document-processing pipeline: ingest, extract, validate, enrich, and publish
description: Documents flow through fixed sequential stages. Each stage validates its input contract before hand-off; failures queue for repair. Throughput matters less than per-stage correctness.
tasks: Ingest documents from a drop folder
Publish validated records to the warehouse
safety_requirements: Quarantine malformed documents, never drop silently
integration_requirements: Object storage for drop folder and quarantine
